messages:
nisha: quick idea — add a 'deploy checklist generator' to deploy-bot. it would append a checklist to the PR body and create a post-deploy checklist thread so engineers don't have to copy/paste every release.
ben: +1. what fields do we need? pins, change window, rollback command, smoke endpoints, obs links?
sam: could the bot also mark checkboxes and update status when GH webhooks fire? that'd be handy.
kat: we already have /deploy start --pin=... but no checklist creation. i can reuse the release-template service for this.
sre_rita: important: checklist should include 'validate model version' and 'run evals on canary traffic' for our inference deploys.
deploy-bot: prototype command available: `/deploy template gen --type=canary --pin=v1.4.2` returns a markdown checklist snippet.
ben: can we include a cost budget line and a token estimate? ops teams ask for that every release.
nisha: minimal MVP fields: pin version, change-window (start/end), canary smoke URLs, rollback snippet, observability links, release notes link, oncall contact.
kat: sketching a markdown template now, e.g.:
```
- [ ] Pin version: v1.4.2
- [ ] Change window: 2026-03-17T22:00Z -> 2026-03-17T23:00Z
- [ ] Canary smoke: GET https://canary.redwood/health -> 200
- [ ] Rollback: `/deploy rollback --pin=v1.4.1 --force`
- [ ] Observability: https://console.redwood/release/123
- [ ] Release notes posted: <link>
```
sam: nice. also add `checkbox-id` metadata so the bot can map checks to webhook events.
release_manager: let's not auto-execute rollbacks. bot can suggest a rollback and DM oncall, but require human confirmation before running anything.
sam: idea: `/deploy suggest-rollback --reason=error-rate --dry-run` which posts recommended steps and a compare link.
nisha: proposal: implement `/deploy make-checklist --pr=123 --template=canary --auto-attach=true` which edits the PR body and creates a release checklist thread in releases channel.
kat: i'll own the PR template and UI bits. will add checkbox IDs and a small JS widget to expand details inline.
ben: i'll wire the backend to emit checklist events from the template generator and handle GH webhook callbacks. estimate ~3 days.
sre_rita: audit requirement: record who checked each box and timestamp. also log the checklist snapshot at deploy start.
deploy-bot: can post a status message and update it when boxes are checked via GH webhook. sample status: `Checklist: 2/6 complete — next: run smoke tests`.
release_manager: add a 'rollback playbook' generator that creates a short script and a one-click copy link for oncall.
sam: i'll write a tiny CLI helper to convert checklist entries into deploy job variables (envs).
nisha: timeline — can we get a prototype this sprint? pinging @kat @ben to pair on the first cut. :raised_hands:
ben: i'll take backend work, start tomorrow.
kat: i'll do PR template + widget, aim for EOW.
deploy-bot: created task: TASK-4321 (deploy-checklist-generator) and posted a stub PR link: https://gh.redwood/s/repo/pull/456
release_manager: once we have the prototype, update the playbook and ship a short doc snippet for release notes authors.
nisha: sweet — i'll draft a tiny RFC and add owners, will follow up in this thread.
